mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, with t-test p-value > 0.05 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in > 50% of instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening supply-side capacity, which signals economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% year-over-year signals persistent inflationary pressure, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, which increases equity discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in > 50% of instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% combined with rising non-farm payrolls signals tight labor market conditions, which may lead to wage pressures and inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a supply shock with weakening demand, which reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases.
